texts.headline: A visual quote builder for your website
texts.subheadline: Your customer picks what they need, sees the result while choosing and gets an estimate. You get the request with every choice already in it.
texts.demosNote: This is a demo to show you the product. It is not set up for your daily work.
how: The visitor configures the product and watches the result change.
The price updates live, as an estimate that you confirm later.
You get the request by WhatsApp or email, with a printable quote.
forWho: Businesses that sell products with options and quote by hand, one message at a time.
Shops that keep getting vague questions like how much for this.
Owners who want the price question answered while the visitor is still on the page.
texts.contactBody: Tell me what you sell and how you charge for it. I show you how Quote could work in your case.
texts.footer: Interactive quote builders for products with options. Built by Lokebox.

setup: Quote tool with your logo, your colors and your texts.
Your product with all its options and variants.
A preview that changes while the visitor picks options.
Price on screen, shown the way you sell.
Leads with the full configuration, by WhatsApp or by form.
Your prices loaded and checked with you.
monthly: Your page online, with your address and its certificate.
Orders saved with the full configuration.
Simple content and price changes on what already exists.
Support from the team that built it.
